convos:
## lately-d28 after Rowan's death — lately with Joshua (d28)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I’ll come back to help."
NPC: "Thank you. I won't forget who fed me when it mattered."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: As I said — They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Forget I said anything. What did you want?"

> YOU PICK [confront:d_ngf0rth] 
YOU: "You said something odd the other day. Let's talk about it."
NPC: "Never mind."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: Like I said — They are no longer available to receive help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
## lately-d41 after Joshua's death — lately with Zuri (d41)
> YOU PICK [gq:yn:yes] 
YOU: "Yes."
NPC: "I see." They take a moment to think about your answer.

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm listening."
NPC: Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me about them."
NPC: "It's my brother, Jacob. Went up in the Taking with the boring half. He was the funniest person I knew. Their metrics are broken. Some nights I dream about the pods -- rows of them, humming. I wake up and I can't tell if it was a dream or a broadcast."

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I'll ask the System about the pods."
NPC: "You'd do that? Ask it? ...Thank you. Really. Even asking is more than the silence."

> YOU PICK [agency:ask_expedition] 
YOU: "What did you see out there?"
NPC: "This one — African Amaranth. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."

> YOU PICK [agency:ask_field] 
YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "a cellar full of jars — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on what was on their mind."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm listening."
NPC: "What got you through the first week? The very first days."
## lately-d47 after Zuri's death — lately with Paola (d47)
> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Take your time."
NPC: "Come see what I found. You won't believe it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "I’m listening."
NPC: "That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind? You know?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Woo-jun always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "I oil boots on rest days. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Nobody says Woo-jun's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I'm picking up Woo-jun's share of the work. Someone should, and it might as well be me."
## lately-d47 after Woo-jun's death — lately with Paola (d47)
> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sure — what's on your mind? Trust me. Mostly."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Woo-jun is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on what's been happening. Doesn't matter now."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"

> YOU PICK [ans:q_kindness:a_tell] 
YOU: "I've watched people share food they couldn't spare. Quiet. No performance. Just... did it."
NPC: "That's the good stuff. Quiet generosity. It's holding this whole thing together. Anyway, that's me."
## lately-d53 after Sam's death — lately with Paola (d53)
> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "That's the whole of it. Sorry."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Yeah? What's up?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Last time things were different. They always are." "I know you and Woo-jun were close. I'm sorry."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "...Sorry, lost my train of thought."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sure — what's on your mind? What's the worst that happens."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:grief] 
YOU: "We never finished — grief, 6 days back."
NPC: "About grief — yeah, we never did get back to that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "You alright?"
NPC: "You're kind. Don't let this place change that."

## lately-d93 after Jovan's death — lately with Yara (d93)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "I did the count twice. The count doesn't change. Meet me at the old burn east of camp and we'll fill packs before dark."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: There is no playable joint foraging outing yet. Giving food does not perform the promised outing.

> YOU PICK [dlg:cant] 
YOU: "I can’t right now."
NPC: "No, yeah, of course. Forget I asked." They won't forget. They'll just stop asking.

YOU: "I'm listening, I promise."

> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept]

NPC: You walk to the trap line with Yara. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that favor."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm listening, I promise."
NPC: A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that favor. That's still where we are."
## lately-d93 after Somchai's death — lately with Yara (d93)
> YOU PICK [confront:d_qk4b4g8] 
YOU: "I need to ask you something."
NPC: "I wasn't a pharmacist. I was an interpreter. I was ashamed of the truth. Out here nobody asks, so I stopped telling."

> YOU PICK [confront:d_zusjhik] 
YOU: "I need to ask you something."
NPC: "I don't actually want to belong somewhere. I want to be left alone. I was embarrassed. Everyone here was someone, and I was... that."

> YOU PICK [confront:d_1oqg67m] 
YOU: "You said something odd the other day. Let's talk about it."
NPC: "We went over this," Yara says, a little tired. "I already told you the truth about that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "I’m listening."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that question."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm listening, I promise."
NPC: They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that question. That's still where we are."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm listening, I promise."
NPC: "Okay. We'll pick this up later."
